objective: Produce an isolated side-by-side native Android QA APK for actual Genesis opening music and 13 animated avatar/guide QA, with no OTA or production/staging package replacement.
chosenApproach: Explicit QA-only app config, independent Android package and disabled updates, blocked push token writes, offline JS release APK with full signed-debug-key native assets, downloadable only from CI artifact.

Existing paid backend remains shared; only use test account for device QA
The app still includes real intro and 13 sprites plus existing approved Godot game files
AdMob uses test application ID in QA

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: A gated QA-only app.config.js changes package, runtime and update settings exclusively for standalone local testing; all production and staging defaults, signer, channels and release processes remain intact.

The existing signed staging package org.mzbministry.buklod.staging and runtime 2.0.4-genesis-library-godot remain unchanged without opt-in

Release-bundled Android QA artifact uses test-only signing, never the registered EAS keystore

selectionRationale: Separate QA installation avoids overwriting signed Genesis staging, and avoids OTA publication while allowing speaker/animation testing. Earlier debug APK was Metro-dependent; this QA compiles a release bundle with Android debug signing so it runs without a development server. QA clone of the existing Firebase Android config is generated runner-only to satisfy native build, while push registration is blocked; Firebase push reliability is outside this media QA scope.
preserveBehaviors: Do not alter main or signed staging native app; independent QA identity is only activated via both CI flags
No backend writes from QA build pipeline and no production OTA or ad publishing
No Google Play access or original EAS keystore required
Retain latest Genesis entry music, portrait assets, 13 sprite frames and PTT audio focus fixes
Existing user profile and DB permissions remain authoritative; QA should use a test account
Staging/live regression gates stay mandatory before any consolidated release
alternativeApproaches: Overwrite existing staging with a debug APK: rejected because signature would not match and current staging install could be lost
Run plain assembleDebug: rejected because APK often requires an external Metro server
Use EAS signed staging APK: rejected as unnecessary signing/OTA identity and potential cloud build credits
Create new Firebase project or change production keys: rejected as unnecessary for offline media QA
